verdict.rationale: Neon's branching model creates isolated, ephemeral database copies (including isolated auth environments) for testing without touching production, and this is explicitly documented for agentic workflows: 'run safe schema migrations and query optimizations on temporary Neon branches, keeping production untouched until changes are validated,' and 'Every database branch gets its own isolated auth environment, so you can test sign-up, login, and OAuth flows in preview or CI branches without touching production.' The MCP server and CLI expose branch creation/reset/restore programmatically for agents, and community evidence corroborates branching for test/reset workflows (neon-comm-10). missing for 10: independent hands-on verification specifically confirming data isolation guarantees under agent-driven test workflows, and no case study showing an AI agent using this sandbox pattern end-to-end in production.
